Application.Text1:
experiments:
id: E1
summary: 早期3D内分泌簇出现与双激素簇
source_locator: Results 3.1; Fig1-2; S1-S3; V1-5
evidence_kind: observation
sample_scope: CS16-CS18
method: modified iDISCO+ LSFM
markers: 
  [1] SOX9
  [2] INS
  [3] GCG
  [4] SST
denominator: 9 specimens for bihormonal presence

Application.Text2:
experiments:
id: E2
summary: 内分泌簇到上皮中心及树内/树外分布
source_locator: Results 3.2; Fig3; S4; V6
evidence_kind: observation
sample_scope: CS16-CS23 and fetal
method: 3D LSFM + 2D validation
markers: 
  [1] SOX9
  [2] INS
  [3] GCG
  [4] SST
denominator: 3 pancreases for centroid profiles; 4-5 samples per stage for intercalated fraction

Application.Text3:
experiments:
id: E3
summary: 簇数量与总体积组成
source_locator: Results 3.2; Fig4A-M
evidence_kind: observation
sample_scope: CS16 to fetal PCW10-13
method: 3D LSFM
markers: 
  [1] INS
  [2] GCG
  [3] SST
denominator: 23 samples across stages for counts; n=4 fetal for volume composition

Application.Text4:
experiments:
id: E4
summary: 胚胎/胎儿与成年胰岛大小和细胞径向分布对照
source_locator: Results 3.3; Fig4N-S
evidence_kind: observation
sample_scope: CS20; fetal PCW11/13; adult
method: 3D + separate 2D morphology; external adult 3D dataset
markers: 
  [1] INS
  [2] GCG
  [3] SST
  [4] Hoechst-33342
denominator: 3 samples per age; at least25 islets per sample for radial distributions

Application.Text5:
processing:
id: P1
summary: 胚胎和胎儿胰腺采用修订iDISCO+固定、免疫染色和透明
source_locator: Methods 2.2
evidence_kind: reported_processing
duration: null (as recorded in source)
temperature: null (as recorded in source)
reason_unknown: Detailed conditions referred to refs4/5, not supplied in this article

Application.Text6:
processing:
id: P2
summary: 3D扫描物镜4×，数字缩放1.66×，像素大小0.979μm
source_locator: Methods 2.2
evidence_kind: reported_readout
pixel_size_um: 0.979
axial_resolution_um: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text7:
processing:
id: P3
summary: 簇数、体积及分布按先前研究；树内外判断使用各簇到SOX9+上皮最短距离
source_locator: Methods 2.3
evidence_kind: reported_analysis
distance_threshold: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text8:
processing:
id: P4
summary: 2D验证为福尔马林固定、石蜡包埋切片染色，非透明整体样本
source_locator: Methods 2.4
evidence_kind: reported_processing
duration: null (as recorded in source)

Application.Text9:
processing:
id: P5
summary: PCW10双阳性计数每样本至少100个INS+细胞，n=3；FIJI人工计数
source_locator: Methods 2.5; SFig3
evidence_kind: reported_analysis
denominator: INS+ cells, not all endocrine cells

Application.Text10:
processing:
id: P6
summary: PyCreas测量各类细胞径向位置；每样本至少25胰岛、每年龄n=3；0中心、1边缘
source_locator: Methods 2.5
evidence_kind: reported_analysis
statistics: Wilcoxon matched-pairs signed-rank tests

Application.Text11:
observations:
id: O1
summary: INS/GCG/SST三类最早在CS16背侧胰芽检出；CS16-18簇少，每簇约1-5细胞
source_locator: Results3.1; Fig1; V1
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text12:
observations:
id: O2
summary: CS16-18共9个样本中7个发现双激素簇；INS/SST为3/9、INS/GCG为2/9、GCG/SST为2/9
source_locator: Results3.1; Fig2; S1-2; V2-5
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text13:
observations:
id: O3
summary: 双激素簇的3D共定位由CS17-18二维单细胞染色支持；簇双阳性不能自动等同每个细胞双阳性
source_locator: Fig2; S1-2
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text14:
observations:
id: O4
summary: 胎儿PCW10约5% INS+细胞仍呈INS/GCG双阳性；n=3，分母INS+细胞
source_locator: Results3.1; SFig3
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text15:
observations:
id: O5
summary: 未检出三激素阳性细胞；检测阴性只限作者已分析标本与染色条件
source_locator: Results3.1
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text16:
observations:
id: O6
summary: 内分泌簇更靠近原基纵轴与中心，边缘罕见；中心生态位为推测
source_locator: Results3.2; Fig3A-F; V6
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text17:
observations:
id: O7
summary: 早期多位于SOX9+树内，胎儿约半数在树外；跨标本空间差异不直接证明细胞迁移轨迹
source_locator: Results3.2; Fig3G-I; SFig4
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text18:
observations:
id: O8
summary: INS与SST簇在CS22起明显增多；GCG簇在胎儿阶段增多
source_locator: Results3.2; Fig4G-I
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text19:
observations:
id: O9
summary: 胎儿INS簇数少于SST但体积更大，INS体积约占总内分泌体积一半；不是占全胰腺体积
source_locator: Fig4J-M; Results3.2
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text20:
observations:
id: O10
summary: CS20最小体积档<25000μm³比例75.33±2.30%；胎儿<100000μm³比例88.52±0.66%；正文和Fig4P权重口径冲突，数值不作为簇数占比自动使用
source_locator: Results3.3; Fig4P
evidence_kind: source_conflict

Application.Text21:
observations:
id: O11
summary: 成年INS簇平均体积正文描述为3200000至6400000μm³；成年3D对照来自外部既有数据集，不是本轮新增透明实验
source_locator: Results3.3; Fig4P reference9
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text22:
observations:
id: O12
summary: 胎儿INS较中心，GCG/SST较周边；成年三类分布无明显同样偏好
source_locator: Fig4Q-S; Methods2.5
evidence_kind: observation

Application.Text23:
